nameOrigin: soft like cotton, a natural material

pokedexEntries.bk: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

pokedexEntries.wh: They go wherever the wind takes them. On rainy days, their bodies are heavier, so they take shelter beneath big trees.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

pokedexEntries.as: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

pokedexEntries.su: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.

pokedexEntries.mo: Pillows and beds stuffed with cotton exhaled by Cottonee are soft and puffy, light and airy— altogether top quality.

pokedexEntries.us: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can’t move as well.

pokedexEntries.um: When attacked, it expels cotton from its body to create a diversion. The cotton it loses grows back in quickly.

pokedexEntries.sw: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

pokedexEntries.sh: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’s highly prized by many luxury brands.
